items.difficulty_reason: Four-step comparison: f^* preserves both categories (cited), the adjunction map has parasitic kernel and cokernel (cited), flat pullback keeps them parasitic (cited parasitic lemma), and the induced map between the pullback of Q and Q of the pullback is an isomorphism by the parasitic-cohomology exactness criterion.
